ashley: Thanks for joining today — quick follow-up from the AH Q&A. Two small clarifications on the model rollout timeline and eval hooks. TL;DR: staged rollout + public eval harness by GA. links below. :memo:
ben: timeline recap? I missed the exact canary window.
ashley: canary starts 2026-08-02 for internal tenants, 2-week burn, then 10% external traffic for 1 week before broad shift. GA target 2026-09-01.
olivia: eval hooks — will customers be able to push eval suites or just use ours?
ashley: customers can upload eval sets to a private space (private-evals) and we will run them against canary builds. Public curated evals will be published in the console.
ci-bot: note: "create-eval-harness" job created in CI for 2026-07-10; owners: eng-ml + devex.
mike: doc ask  need a short how-to for customers to add an eval suite (format, limits, privacy). Can someone own this?
olivia: I can draft the how-to + schema sample. target 2026-07-08.
ben: risk: if canary fails, what's fallback behavior? automatic rollback or traffic split?
ashley: automatic rollback on 5% error rate spike; otherwise traffic trims back to previous stable variant and ops get paged. Full rollback runbook lives in the runbooks repo.
ci-bot: reminder posted in #eng-ml at 3723456800: "eval-harness: owners/links/next-steps"
ashley: action list: 1) eval how-to + schema (olivia) - 2026-07-08; 2) CI job & infra (eng-ml) - 2026-07-10; 3) rollout runbook refresh (mike + eng-runtime) - 2026-07-15; 4) console UI for private evals (devex + product) - 2026-08-01. I'll open threads in #eng-ml and #devex for the specifics. Links: RFC: https://redwood.example.com/rfc/model-rollout-evals-2026, AH slides: https://slides.redwood.example.com/ah-jul-2026#evals. Ping me to be added to owners. :sparkles:
